t: Sandtex 10Ltr Smooth Plymouth Grey Masonry Paint is a high-quality, water-based solution for exterior surfaces. This extra durable masonry paint features advanced Microseal Technology, providing excellent weather protection and a smooth finish. It is waterproof and dirt resistant, making it ideal for refreshing exterior walls, garden structures, or commercial buildings. The paint is formulated for easy application by brush, roller, or spray, offering exceptional coverage of 16m²/Ltr on concrete, pebble-dash, render, and stone. With a touch-dry time of 3-4 hours and recoat time of 3-4 hours, projects can be completed efficiently, ensuring a long-lasting, professional result.
b: Suitable for Concrete, Pebble-Dash, Render & Stone
